🔬 Full History

Rules: on each month's first price, rank stocks by trailing return over the lookback; optionally keep only stocks above their 10-month average; walk down the ranking and buy the top N equally, skipping any stock whose sector is already full (if a cap is set); never sell. SPY/QQQ/QQQM are benchmarks, never picked.
Sectors: built-in GICS-style map for your 496 tickers. Tickers not in the map () count as their own sector. Second share classes are never picked, so one company can't take two slots (skipped: ). A cap can leave fewer than N picks (e.g. 20 stocks with max 1 per sector).
Random baseline: "Avg eligible" is the exact expected result of picking at random from the same filtered list. Prices as given in your file; no taxes or trading costs.
